settings.repere: Bouton ou lien · How long will a box last?
settings.text: How long will a box last?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Each pound of dehydrated food equates …
settings.text:
Each pound of dehydrated food equates to about 4 dry cups of food.

Find your dog's daily feeding amount using the feeding guidelines.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Divide that amount by the total dry cu…
settings.text: Divide that amount by the total dry cups in your chosen box (see below).

settings.repere: Paragraphe · 2 lb box = 8 dry cups 4 lb box = 16 dr…
settings.text:
2 lb box = 8 dry cups
4 lb box = 16 dry cups
7 lb box = 28 dry cups
10 lb box = 40 dry cups

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Example: A 30 lb dog with an average a…
settings.text:
Example:

A 30 lb dog with an average activity level is recommended 1 dry cup per day.

If you purchase a 10 lb box (40 dry cups), it will last 40 days.

settings.repere: Bouton ou lien · Can it be mixed with dry food?
settings.text: Can it be mixed with dry food?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes! Dehydrated food is great as a com…
settings.text: Yes! Dehydrated food is great as a complete meal, topper to your dog's favorite dry food or used with enrichment toys like lick mats.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · While you can use as much or as little…
settings.text: While you can use as much or as little as you'd like, we recommend mixing half of the suggested serving of your dog's dry food with half the suggested serving of dehydrated food. Adjust as needed to avoid overfeeding.

settings.repere: Bouton ou lien · Is dehydrated food considered raw?
Paragraphe · No, our dehydrated food has been gentl…
settings.text: No, our dehydrated food has been gently cooked prior to dehydration. Specifically, the proteins we use are cooked to an internal temperature of at least 165ºF to ensure they're safe and free of pathogens.

settings.repere: Bouton ou lien · What does it mean to be human grade?
settings.text: What does it mean to be human grade?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Being human grade means that every ing…
settings.text: Being human grade means that every ingredient in The Honest Kitchen's pet food meets the same safety and quality standards required for human food.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our suppliers must adhere to strict gu…
settings.text: Our suppliers must adhere to strict guidelines, including human-edible status from harvest through production, adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices, non-GMO ingredient usage, and freedom from chemicals or adulterants.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Each supplier provides a signed 'Human…
settings.text:
Each supplier provides a signed 'Human Food Grade Guarantee' and undergoes audits to ensure compliance.

Additionally, it means that all of our foods are manufactured in a facility that meets all the safety standards of human food facilities.

settings.repere: Bouton ou lien · What if my dog doesn't like the food?
settings.text: What if my dog doesn't like the food?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · All of our products are backed by our …
settings.text:
All of our products are backed by our 90 day money-back guarantee. If your pet doesn't like the food, please contact our customer support team at questions@thehonestkitchen.com.

Please note that some sales and short dated products may not be eligible for refunds. This will be noted in the sale terms and conditions.
